Totally fine to start from zero. The simplest path is this:
Start with the Foundations guide
Open: https://help.kajabi.com/articles/get-started/foundations/foundations-start-here
Follow the nine steps in order: validate your idea, set your brand, add your instructor details, build a waitlist, connect payments, create your first product, price it, design your website, then test the purchase before you promote it.
Use Cofounder after you sign up
Cofounder sits inside your dashboard and gives you a checklist of the next actions to take. It helps you move from idea to launch step by step. 
Start with the Basic trial
The trial lasts 14 days and includes the core tools: products, website builder, email, landing pages, checkout, and one community.
Kajabi is built for beginners. You can launch one course or coaching offer first, then expand later as your audience grows. 
If you want, I can also walk you through the exact first product to create.

In short: beginners appreciate that they can start simple and expand when they are ready.
